name: VehicleAllocationPlanner
tagline: Share every month's vehicle supply fairly with turn-and-earn, run the dealer offer–accept–swap round and lock the allocation – in one drop-in Power Apps component.
description: A complete OEM / importer vehicle allocation app for Power Apps and Power Pages: dealer × model/trim planner grid with earned and requested units, supply pools with fair-share auto-allocation, an acceptance board for offers, partial acceptances, declines, swaps and counter-offers, an allocation register and KPIs for acceptance, overdue responses, free units and days supply. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to any table in a few clicks.
features: Turn-and-earn earned allocation (sales rate × target days − stock)
Earned cap with strategic override reason
Pool supply that cannot be over-allocated (configurable)
Offer, accept, partial accept, decline, swap and counter-offer workflow
Returned units flow back to the pool
Low-acceptance warning for next period's earning
Bulk offer / response date / manager, CSV export, undo
Demo mode with a fictional importer network
